title: Canonical hover exception (compiler Task 1)
description: A page-local override of a binding: when an occurrence must NOT inherit the canonical payload (page-local context, source-card mismatch, scholarly iʿrāb override, owner style, or an unsafe homograph). Names the binding it overrides and, optionally, a replacement canonical payload. Review-gated. Dry-run; source-clean. See CANONICAL_HOVER_PAYLOAD_COMPILER_PLAN (fablehardening).
